literal.prompt: Какое арктическое море простирается от северных побережий Норвегии и России до Новой Земли на востоке?

literalGroups.primaryGround: NPI identifies the Barents Sea and places its southern boundary along northern Norway and Russia; NOAA names the Arctic Ocean as smallest; Australian Antarctic Program locates the Weddell and Ross sea sectors relative to the Transantarctic Mountains.
literalGroups.locator: NPI L0-L2; NOAA L4-L10; AAP L305-L307

literalGroups.literal: Это Баренцево море. Его южная граница проходит у берегов Северной Норвегии и России; атлантические воды движутся здесь на восток и север.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPI says Atlantic water flows eastward and northward and that its supply makes parts of the Barents Sea comparatively accessible for most of the year. The revised sentence states only the supported direction of flow, not a claim that the sea is ice-free.

literalGroups.literal: Баренцево море простирается на север до 80° северной широты.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPI places the south coast of the Barents Sea at northern Norway and Russia and its eastern extent at Novaya Zemlya.

literalGroups.literal: Северный Ледовитый океан — самый маленький из пяти океанических бассейнов Земли.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NOAA explicitly identifies the Arctic Ocean as the smallest of the five ocean basins.

literalGroups.literal: Юго-западный угол моря Уэдделла примыкает к Трансантарктическим горам.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Australian Antarctic Program places the southwestern corner of the Weddell Sea at the Transantarctic Mountains.

literalGroups.literal: Трансантарктические горы доходят до северо-западного угла моря Росса.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Australian Antarctic Program places the northwestern corner of the Ross Sea at the Transantarctic Mountains.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: The key is uniquely the Barents Sea: NPI directly places the southern boundary at northern Norway and Russia. Its note adds a distinct eastern extent, Novaya Zemlya, beyond the prompt and key.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: The Arctic Ocean is an ocean rather than a sea adjoining these two coasts; the note teaches its supported identifying fact, that it is the smallest ocean basin.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: The correct-option note adds the Barents Sea’s northern limit at 80° N. NPI L2 gives this extent. This fact is absent from the prompt and answer label.

absoluteDifficulty.assessment: MEDIUM for an adult with thematic familiarity in polar geography: identify a sea from its Norwegian/Russian southern coast and eastern limit at Novaya Zemlya. This requires recall of regional boundaries; a non-specialist cannot solve it from common everyday knowledge or eliminate all alternatives. No change to frozen difficulty.
